description: Unit test class for testing paragraph rendering features in the MigraDoc PDF rendering library, including text, formatting, alignment, borders, tab stops, and document fields.

classes.name: TestParagraphRenderer
classes.description: A class containing static methods to test various paragraph rendering features in MigraDoc.

methods.name: TextAndBlanks
methods.description: Tests rendering of text interleaved with blank characters.

methods.name: Formatted
methods.description: Tests adding formatted text to a paragraph.

methods.name: FillFormattedParagraph
methods.description: Fills a paragraph with formatted text in different styles and sizes.

methods.name: Alignment
methods.description: Tests paragraph alignment and indentation settings.

methods.name: Tabs
methods.description: Tests tab stop functionality in paragraphs.

methods.name: GiveBorders
methods.description: Applies border styles and shading to a paragraph.

methods.name: Fields
methods.description: Tests insertion of document fields like section, page, and date fields.
